title: Mechanism & endgame reactor sounds v12
provenance: Made for ReMatter on the owner's machine. Tonal, motion and digital layers are synthesised by the project's own studio code; foley layers are cut from takes generated locally with the Apache-2.0 text-to-audio model MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0 (mlx-community 4-bit port) from the prompts recorded below. No third-party recordings and no vanilla Minecraft sounds are contained. Four dedicated endgame roles (deep_extractor, transmutation_reactor, primal_reactor, energy_matrix) were added in workshop-v12 using warm noise-free additive & phase-locked synthesis, measured from decoded Vorbis PCM.

copier_scan_s11.prompt: A photocopier scanning, the light bar sweeps slowly across and back with a low whirring and a soft thunk at the end.

tube_whoosh_s11.prompt: A pneumatic tube canister sucked away with a soft whoosh, again and again.

fridge_compressor_s11.prompt: A refrigerator compressor humming steadily, low and smooth.

vat_simmer_s11.prompt: A large steel vat simmering slowly behind a wall, deep soft bubbles and liquid rushing in pipes.

crush_rocks_s11.prompt: Rocks cracking and crunching as they are crushed inside a steel housing.

grind_quern_s11.prompt: A heavy stone quern turned slowly by hand, stone grinding on stone with a low gritty rumble.

block_set_s11.prompt: A solid stone block set down on a wooden workbench with a soft thud, again and again, slowly.

crystal_ticks_s11.prompt: Crystals forming with soft ticks and small clinks, slow and sparse.

simmer_fine_s11.prompt: Liquid gently simmering in laboratory glassware with fine tiny bubbles, calm and quiet.

glass_clink_s11.prompt: Laboratory glass flasks touching with soft single clinks, slow and sparse.

furnace_roar_s11.prompt: The low steady roar of heat inside a small closed furnace.

air_burst_s11.prompt: A short burst of compressed air released from a tank, again and again.

caddy_bay_s11.prompt: A hard drive caddy pushed into a bay, the latch closing with a clack, again and again.

valve_puff_s11.prompt: A pneumatic valve clicks and lets out a short soft puff of air, again and again.

cartridge_slot_s11.prompt: A plastic cartridge sliding into a metal slot and clicking into place, again and again, slowly.

selector_switch_s11.prompt: A rotary selector switch turned one step at a time with a solid clunk, slowly.

grind_mortar_s11.prompt: A mortar and pestle crushing rock salt with a dull crunch, close perspective.

crank_ratchet_s11.prompt: A hand crank with a ratchet being turned slowly, wooden handle, coarse clicks.

mill_turn_s11.prompt: One slow turn of a stone hand mill, a short gritty scrape ending with a wooden knock, again and again.

vault_bolts_s11.prompt: Heavy vault door bolts locking one after another with deep metallic clunks.

ratchet_heavy_s11.prompt: A heavy socket ratchet wrench turning back with slow distinct coarse clicks.

bolt_panel_s11.prompt: A bolt breaking loose with a crack, then a heavy metal panel coming off with a clunk.
